description: This file contains CSS styles for theming and layout of a React application. It defines CSS variables for light and dark themes, styles for various components such as App and theme-toggle button, and includes media queries for responsive design.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container for the application that centers content and manages background color based on theme.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header section of the application that aligns items in the center and changes background color based on theme.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Link component that changes color based on theme.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button for toggling between light and dark themes, styled with transitions and hover effects.
